services.desc: Imagine your special event set against the backdrop of the Pacific Ocean, where history and beauty come together. Hulihe‘e Palace, once a royal retreat, offers a one-of-a-kind venue in the heart of Kailua-Kona. Built in 1838, the Palace is filled with treasures from Hawai‘i’s monarchy and surrounded by lush lawns and swaying palms. Whether you're planning a wedding, reception, dinner, or gathering, the Palace provides a peaceful and elegant setting. Say “I do” as the sun sets over the bay, with ocean breezes and the sound of waves creating a natural soundtrack. Host guests in the grand entry hall, where redwood pillars and antique furnishings from the time of Kalākaua add timeless grace.
